speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE) due to perinatal asphyxia. The normal infectious workup and absence of maternal risk factors make TORCH, sepsis, or hypoglycemia unlikely; the clinical presentation of seizures and lethargy three days post-delivery strongly suggests hypoxic injury.
